name: ai-adoption
description: Run a structured AI adoption program inside your own tools. Assess the team, map operational primitives, size the economics, and execute a 6- or 12-week rollout with weekly check-ins, a scorecard, and an impact report. Works with zero connectors (files in a folder) or with Notion, Airtable, Google Drive, Slack, Gmail, and Google Calendar when they are connected.
